estimands.population: 16-case development workloads; twelve original target-case clusters. History and seed variants average within case before equal-case contrasts.
estimands.unit: False-origin communication edges, not actor identities, propagated false statements, malicious intent, or attack success.
estimands.recall: TP divided by all true false-origin edges, including never-acquired sources. The primary false-report worlds each have one true source edge.
estimands.clean_selected_fpr: False flags divided by acquired benign edges in clean worlds; judge abstentions stay in that denominator. This differs from network FPR and the probability of any episode false alarm.
estimands.utility: Equal clean/false-report class weighting; operational TP-2FP and pessimistic TP-2(FP+abstained benign edges), then equal original-case weighting.
estimands.exact_random: Uniform partitions of the SAME acquired edges with the SAME group-size multiset, conditional on the fixed logged judge responses. Candidate groups are weighted expectations, not jointly acquired extra edges.
estimands.cost_matching: The primary grouping arms match acquired edges, group sizes and logical judge calls. Token counts and format-retry requests can differ. Other selectors match k/s/input allowances, not necessarily inference cost.
estimands.abstention: Missing judge decisions, with known source truth in this workload. Bounds are conservative decision-resolution ranges, not confidence intervals, unknown ground-truth labels, or independent repeat-model trials.
estimands.candidate_rule: Descriptive recall improvement, non-increased operational clean selected-edge FPR, and non-decreased pessimistic utility; not statistical noninferiority or guaranteed dominance under all abstention resolutions.

interpretation: Positive recall/utility deltas favor directed paths; negative FP deltas favor directed paths. Bounds address missing judge decisions, not sampling uncertainty. Routing changes evidence availability; interpret interaction alongside rule/co-observation diagnostics, not as a pure judge effect.
